zh-CN.name: 抖音博主分析师
zh-CN.shortDesc: 从主页、作品链接或本地视频分析博主，拆解开头、正文和互动，整理成账号报告或实拍案例。默认启用 Rea-Video，首次分析由 uv 准备 CLI，需 Git、FFmpeg 和 ffprobe。

en-US.name: Douyin Creator Analyst
en-US.shortDesc: Research creators from a profile, individual links or local videos. Get timestamped breakdowns, an account report or filming exercises. Rea-Video is enabled by default; first use provisions the CLI through uv and needs Git, FFmpeg and ffprobe.
